watches.name: Terra Nova Jumping Hour Aventurine
watches.description: Limited to just 50 pieces worldwide, this exclusive edition pairs a deep blue Aventurine dial with a delicately frosted 904L stainless steel case, creating a striking interplay of shimmer, depth and refined geometry. The cushion-shaped 40.5mm profile maintains the Terra Nova’s contemporary field watch proportions, while the frosted finish introduces a unique lustre, catching the light with countless subtle facets across the case surface. Cut and polished using diamond tools, each Aventurine dial reveals constellations of sparkle beneath its rich midnight tone. Two clean, offset apertures display the hour and minute indications, offering the Jumping Hour’s signature left-to-right flow and allowing the brilliance of the dial to remain centre stage. White Super-LumiNova® accents, a silver minute track and a full-luminous central seconds hand ensure clarity and presence in all lighting conditions. At its heart lies the exclusive BC634 calibre, developed with Sellita under a dedicated partnership. This high-torque movement delivers an instantaneous hour jump—executed in under one tenth of a second, bringing precision, drama and mechanical purity to the display. With a 56-hour power reserve and crisp running seconds, it balances technical ingenuity with everyday reliability. Finished on a quick-release blue gradient leather strap, the Terra Nova Jumping Hour Aventurine is a sophisticated, contemporary expression of a rare complication. Crafted for the discerning collector, it combines mechanical innovation with the quiet luxury of fine materials and limited production, an elegant statement within the Terra Nova collection.

watches.name: Supernova 41mm Chronograph Hawking Edition Rubber Strap
watches.description: Created in celebration of the life and work of Professor Stephen Hawking, the Supernova Hawking Limited Edition is the second collaboration between Bremont and the Hawking family, and the first Wayfinder Hawking design within the contemporary, space-inspired Supernova collection. Inspired by Hawking's pioneering research into black holes, it is a timepiece informed by discovery, designed with purpose and built to endure. Crafted in a 41mm ultra black DLC-treated 904L stainless steel case, the Supernova Hawking embodies the advanced engineering and uncompromising construction that define the Supernova collection . Its highly technical, geometric aesthetic is inspired by modern spacecraft engineering, while the complex sandwich-style construction echoes Bremont's signature Trip-Tick® case design. A multi-faceted decahedral black ceramic bezel, angular case architecture and layered surfaces evoke the depth and mystery of black holes, reinforcing the watch's conceptual foundation. The intricate dial draws inspiration from spacecraft solar arrays, featuring an interlocking galvanic black grid design with triangular pathways that draw the eye inward. Genuine meteorite sub-dials at 3 and 9 o'clock reinforce its connection to deep space, while Stephen Hawking's name appears alongside his black hole entropy equation at 6 o'clock, paying tribute to one of his most groundbreaking scientific achievements. Triangular applied indexes filled with white Super-LumiNova® (blue emission) and rhomboidal black gold hands ensure exceptional legibility while maintaining the bold architectural design language. Powering the watch is the chronometer -rated BC77 automatic movement, delivering exceptional precision alongside a 62-hour power reserve. Turning the watch over reveals a striking exhibition case back featuring a swirling black hole motif, through which the decorated rotor and movement can be admired, offering an artistic interpretation of the phenomenon that inspired the watch. Available on a black rubber strap equipped with a quick-release mechanism for effortless interchangeability, the Supernova Hawking offers exceptional comfort and versatility while complementing its bold, contemporary design. A tribute to one of the most influential theoretical physicists in history, it celebrates scientific discovery while continuing Bremont's pursuit of precision, endurance and exploration, honouring a legacy that forever changed our understanding of the universe.

watches.name: Terra Nova 42.5MM HRR Chronograph Leather Strap
watches.description: The Terra Nova Henley Royal Regatta Chronograph celebrates Bremont's partnership as Official Timing Partner of Henley Royal Regatta , one of the world's most prestigious rowing events. Limited to 150 pieces, the watch pays tribute to the official colours and sporting heritage of the Regatta through a purposeful chronograph designed for precision timing on and off the river. Crafted from lustrous 904L steel, the 42.5mm case is complemented by a royal blue ceramic stroke counter bezel and a crisp white dial. Crossed oars at 12 o'clock and a dedicated stroke counter allow the wearer to measure stroke rate and cadence during racing or training, operated via the chronograph pusher. Long associated with regatta timing, the function reflects the precision and sporting heritage of competitive rowing. Legibility remains paramount throughout the design. Navy applied numerals, indexes and a detailed minute track are enhanced with next generation Super-LumiNova® for visibility in all conditions. Navy blue sub-dials contrast elegantly against the white dial, while polished rhodium-plated hands feature Super-LumiNova® infill. The striking deckchair green chronograph hand takes inspiration from the iconic Henley Royal Regatta deckchairs that line the riverbank of the Stewards' Enclosure. The Henley Royal Regatta logo sits proudly above the date window at 6 o'clock, while for the first time 'Henley-on-Thames' appears on the dial in tribute to the town's rich rowing heritage and the home of Bremont's manufacture, The Wing . Powered by the BC77 automatic chronograph movement with a 62-hour power reserve, the Terra Nova Henley Royal Regatta Chronograph combines purposeful functionality with refined sporting character. Water resistant to 100 metres, it is fitted to a blue embossed leather strap with white stitching and a decorated pin buckle.

watches.name: Terra Nova 40.5mm Jumping Hour 1776 Bracelet
watches.description: Created to mark the 250th anniversary of the United States, the Terra Nova Jumping Hour 1776 is a limited edition of just 250 pieces. The watch celebrates heritage and innovation through Bremont's exclusive jumping hour complication and a design inspired by the pioneering spirit that shaped a nation. The Terra Nova collection draws inspiration from the military pocket watches of the early 20th century, combining a geometric cushion-shaped 904L steel case with a slim profile and shortened lugs. For its American edition, the Terra Nova Jumping Hour 1776 presents a deep blue grained dial carrying the 1776 inscription, a reference to the year of independence. The hour is read through an aperture at 9 o'clock on a roulette-style disc, with the minutes displayed alongside it and a central running seconds hand finished in full Super-LumiNova®. A silver star motif runs through the minute track, while bold red triangles at 3 and 9 o'clock draw the eye towards the centre of the dial. Applied Super-LumiNova® indexes ensure legibility day or night. Read the Journal Turning the watch over reveals a decorated caseback depicting an eagle in full flight above a stars-and-stripes field, framed by stars and individually numbered 1 of 250. Powered by the exclusive BC634AH calibre developed for Bremont with Sellita, the movement delivers a 56-hour power reserve and a jumping hour display that combines mechanical ingenuity with absolute clarity. Discover more about the Jumping Hour complication and the craftsmanship behind its design here. Water resistant to 100 metres, the Terra Nova Jumping Hour 1776 is fitted to a quick-release 904L stainless steel bracelet and limited to 250 pieces worldwide.

watches.name: Altitude MB Meteor Time Zones Blue Dial Bracelet
watches.description: Built for those who navigate the world without limits, the Altitude MB Meteor Time Zones Bracelet is a sophisticated evolution of Bremont’s iconic MB Meteor. Combining world time zone functionality with an intuitive GMT display, the latest addition to the MB collection is engineered for pilots, global travellers and modern explorers who operate across borders, disciplines and environments. Housed within a lightweight yet highly durable 42mm Grade 2 Titanium Trip-Tick® case and paired with a brushed titanium quick release bracelet, the watch reflects Bremont’s uncompromising approach to modern aviation tool watches. The dark blue knurled central barrel and signature twin-crown Roto-Click internal bezel system reinforce the collection’s technical identity while delivering exceptional practicality in daily wear. Designed for intuitive global timekeeping, the bi-directional rotating dial flange displays 24 international time zones for immediate reference across the world at a glance. At the centre of the dial, a clearly defined 24-hour GMT track with day and night indication allows effortless tracking of a second time zone, while a date aperture at 3 o’clock enhances everyday functionality. Executed in Bremont’s distinctive Air Force Blue, the brushed galvanic metal dial delivers clarity, depth and a bold visual signature. Legibility, a defining principle of the MB collection, is enhanced through applied numerals and indexes filled with white Super-LumiNova® with blue emission, alongside gloss black hands designed for maximum contrast in all conditions. A short red triangular-tipped GMT hand provides immediate distinction from the primary handset, while the gloss black seconds hand features Bremont’s signature monochrome pullcord counterweight inspired by Martin-Baker ejection seat handles. Powering the watch is the BB641 automatic movement, operating at 28,800 vibrations per hour with a 56-hour power reserve. As part of the MB series, the movement is protected by Bremont’s rubberised anti-shock mounting and inner soft iron anti-magnetic ring, engineered to perform in demanding environments. Purpose-built and globally minded, the Altitude MB Meteor Time Zones Bracelet reinforces Bremont’s enduring aviation heritage while equipping modern explorers with precision timekeeping wherever the journey leads.

watches.name: Altitude 39mm Blue Dial Bracelet
watches.description: The Altitude 39mm Blue Dial Bracelet is a refined, ultra-durable take on Bremont’s signature MB format, crafted for everyday versatility. Built around a 39mm Trip-Tick case in ultra-durable 904L stainless steel, it features a black DLC-coated centre barrel and a slimmer silhouette that wears effortlessly on the wrist. Engineered for resilience, it offers the same shock protection and anti-magnetic shielding trusted by military personnel and pilots across the globe. The cockpit-inspired dial is clean and highly legible, with applied Super-LumiNova® indexes, and subtle stencilled detailing. The watch retains one of the MB’s most iconic features: the ‘lollipop’ seconds hand counterbalanced by a looped ‘ejection’ pull handle in white and black stripes. Beneath the surface, the BB14, 68-hour power reserve movement is suspended within a flexible rubber mount to absorb shocks and minimise impacts. The Altitude 39mm Blue Dial Bracelet has an open case-back, revealing the movement’s fine finishing in gunmetal grey with Geneva Stripes. The open case-back retains the anti-magnetic shielding, which is provided by a soft iron ring around the movement, based on Faraday Cage principles. For the Altitude 39mm Blue Dial Bracelet, Bremont introduces a new bracelet design, crafted in brushed 904L stainless steel. Featuring quick-release functionality and engineered for maximum flexibility, it is secured with curved bars that enable smooth articulation and exceptional comfort.

The three-part Trip-Tick case has been re-engineered with a slimmer profile and reduced lug-to-lug distance for improved comfort. The dual crowns – one at 2 o’clock for winding and setting, and one at 4 o’clock for operating the bi-directional inner bezel – have been optimised for ergonomics and utility, delivering a much smoother operation. The inner bezel’s Roto-Click technology has also been re-engineered, ensuring effortless and precise action with the pure, satisfying click familiar to MB owners. The dial is designed for absolute legibility with applied Super-LumiNova® indexes, and subtle stencilled detailing. The watch retains one of the MB’s most iconic features: the ‘lollipop’ seconds hand counterbalanced by a looped ‘ejection’ pull handle in white and black stripes. Beneath the surface, the BB14, 68-hour power reserve movement is suspended within a flexible rubber mount to absorb shocks and minimise impacts. The Altitude MB Meteor has an open case-back, revealing the movement’s fine finishing in gunmetal grey with Geneva Stripes. The open case-back retains the anti-magnetic shielding, which is provided by a soft iron ring around the movement, based on Faraday Cage principles. For the Altitude MB Meteor, Bremont introduces a new bracelet design, crafted in brushed titanium. Featuring quick-release functionality and engineered for maximum flexibility, it is secured with curved bars that enable smooth articulation and exceptional comfort. The Altitude MB Meteor Blue Dial Blue Barrel Bracelet is built for those who push limits.

watches.name: Altitude Chronograph Pulsograph Valjoux 23
watches.description: At its core is a meticulously restored ‘new old stock’ Valjoux 23 – a hand-wound column wheel chronograph calibre originally produced from 1916 and celebrated for its refined architecture and reliability. Each movement has been carefully refurbished and hand-finished in collaboration with Chronode, delivering a contemporary interpretation of traditional haute horlogerie. The 42mm Trip-Tick case is crafted from lightweight, high-strength titanium, offering durability while maintaining a slim 12.52mm profile for everyday wear. A sapphire exhibition case back reveals the distinctive Y-shaped bridge and intricate finishing of the movement. The dial draws on classic chronograph design, featuring a warm salmon-pink galvanic finish with a mix of brushed and grained textures. Applied black gold numerals and indexes are filled with white Super-LumiNova® for clarity, while silver sub-dials at 3 and 9 o’clock introduce a subtle two-tone contrast. A pulsometer scale on the dial ring references traditional medical chronographs. watches.name: Supernova 41mm Tourbillon
watches.description: The Supernova Tourbillon represents a new expression of Bremont’s watchmaking, combining contemporary architecture with the precision of a flying tourbillon, powered by the BHC91180 hand-wound movement developed in collaboration with La Joux-Perret. Housed in a 41mm case crafted from high-grade 904L stainless steel, the watch features a complex multi-part construction with a DLC-coated case middle, screw-less case architecture and a multi-faceted black ceramic bezel. The geometric design language, inspired by space exploration, is expressed through brushed and polished surfaces that interact with light across the case, while maintaining a slim 10.72mm profile and integrated bracelet design. The openworked dial is defined by anthracite skeletonised bridges with blue Super-LumiNova® inlays, arranged in a geometric structure that echoes the Supernova collection’s architectural identity. A subtle sunray effect radiates from the flying tourbillon at 6 o’clock, which is secured from the back and completes one rotation per minute to enhance chronometric performance. The skeletonised movement is framed by a black dial flange with blue minute track indexes, while the Bremont logo is applied to the underside of the sapphire crystal, creating a floating effect above the calibre. At its core, the BHC91180 manual-wind movement offers a 60-hour power reserve with a daily rate tolerance of −5 to +5 seconds. Visible through the sapphire crystal, the movement reflects a balance of technical precision and contemporary finishing. Positioned at the forefront of the Supernova collection, the Supernova Tourbillon brings together advanced engineering, architectural design and traditional horology in a contemporary form.

watches.name: Altitude MB Meteor 'Felix The Cat'
watches.description: The Altitude MB Meteor 'Felix the Cat' brings together Bremont's aviation heritage with the unmistakable mischievous spirit of one of the world’s most enduring icons. Closely associated with U.S. Navy aviation squadrons, Felix the Cat has long symbolised courage, good luck and fearless adventure in the skies. Limited to just 500 pieces worldwide and engineered to withstand the extreme testing of Martin-Baker ejection seats, this unique watch celebrates a legacy built on precision, durability, and character. The 42mm Trip-Tick case is crafted from Grade 2 titanium and finished in tactical stealth black DLC, with a knurled PVD titanium barrel and matching crowns. The stealth black dial features applied numerals and indexes filled with high-grade white Super-LumiNova® for maximum clarity, while Felix the Cat appears directly on the dial, cheekily running away with the number 6. Bright yellow accents – inspired by real-world flight safety markings – bring contrast and energy, including the iconic looped ‘ejection’ pull-handle seconds hand, a signature of our MB watches. The bi-directional inner bezel is operated via our Roto-Click mechanism using the crown at 4 o’clock, delivering the precise, tactile action expected from the MB series. Inside, our BB14 automatic movement offers a 68-hour power reserve and is suspended within a shock-absorbing mount with anti-magnetic shielding. Turn the watch over to reveal an open case-back with Felix-inspired decoration and the movement’s gunmetal grey finishing with Geneva Stripes. Available with a matt black DLC titanium bracelet with quick-release functionality, or a textured black leather strap with box-stitch detailing. Limited to 500 pieces worldwide.

watches.name: Altitude Skeletonised Perpetual Calendar GMT

Housed in a lightweight 42mm Trip-Tick titanium case, with a brushed ‘Air Force Blue’ skeleton dial and case barrel, this watch combines two prestigious complications in a design rooted in aviation utility and everyday wearability. The skeletonised blue dial reveals the full architecture of the Perpetual Calendar GMT Mono-pusher’s Agenhor-developed module, transforming the watch into a showcase of mechanical depth and contemporary precision. Open-worked to expose the bridges, finishing and interplay of components beneath, the dial is reinforced with Air Force Blue structural arms that preserve rigidity while enhancing legibility across the subdials. The rotating globe at 12 o’clock, radial date display at 6, intuitive month/leap-year propeller at 3, and propeller-style running seconds at 9 are all presented with exceptional clarity, delivering a rare combination of technical transparency, everyday usability and striking visual impact. Despite its mechanical complexity, all functions are easily adjusted via an integrated mono-pusher crown and discreet correctors. Crafted to deliver enduring performance and refined precision, the Altitude Perpetual Calendar GMT is finished with a glassbox sapphire crystal and is offered on both a titanium bracelet and patinated blue leather strap. A showcase of British design, Swiss horological mastery and high complication craftsmanship — built for those who appreciate the rare and exceptional.

watches.name: Supermarine Full Ceramic, Polar White
watches.description: Bremont introduces the next generation of Supermarine: a 500m Full Ceramic, striking, high-performance timepiece. Built for precision, resilience and versatility, Bremont consistently strives to craft the best tool watches for the most arduous environments. Featuring a mono-block black ceramic case, white ceramic bezel insert, and a knurled detail PVD treated titanium bezel. Crafting a full ceramic case is a meticulous process. Soft ceramic powder is moulded and then sintered at 1,450°C under extreme pressure, shrinking the case by 23% to achieve perfect hardness. The result? A perfectly sand-blasted, extremely scratch-resistant matte finish ceramic case, built to endure any adventure. The 56-hour power reserve automatic movement sits in a titanium container, secured with a PVD treated titanium case back. With an impressive 500-metre water resistance and a helium escape valve, it's engineered for the depths while maintaining precise performance. The full ceramic case not only enhances durability but also adds a sleek, modern aesthetic, making it a watch that performs as brilliantly as it looks, both above and below the waves. The Supermarine Full Ceramic features applied indexes and hands which are filled with blue emission Super-LumiNova® allowing for longstanding and incredibly bright luminosity in the most challenging conditions and adds a touch of magic to your timepiece in low light. Includes our black and grey woven fabric NATO style strap, meticulously woven on 18th century Jacquard French looms. Self-gripping fastening ensures a secure and comfortable fit.

watches.name: Altitude MB Meteor
watches.description: A bold new chapter in our iconic MB series and a vivid tribute to the roots of our long-standing partnership with Martin-Baker. The Altitude MB Meteor with Orange Barrel brings back one of our most recognisable design elements: the striking orange knurled barrel, originally seen on the MBII . It’s more than a flash of colour — it’s a celebration of our aviation heritage and the uncompromising performance that defines every MB watch we build. The Altitude MB Meteor Orange shares the same advanced engineering as the other MB Meteor models . We’ve crafted it with a lightweight yet durable Grade 2 titanium case, refined our Trip-Tick construction for a slimmer profile and improved comfort, and enhanced the Roto-Click inner bezel for even smoother, more precise control. Our dual crowns at 2 and 4 o’clock offer an intuitive, highly functional experience that stays true to our tool watch ethos. Available with a silver or black dial, the watch is designed for clarity and resilience, featuring applied Super-LumiNova® indexes, gloss-finished hands, and our signature red-tipped seconds hand, counterbalanced by the distinctive pullcord loop. The crowning feature of the model is the orange barrel. We undertook extensive research and development to create a shade that defined but exceeded the original MBII , now reimagined with a Cerakote® ceramic coating for exceptional toughness, thermal resistance, and long-term wear. Powering the watch is our trusted BB14 movement with a 68-hour power reserve, anti-shock protection, and anti-magnetic shielding, all visible through an open case back. Like every MB model, it’s been through the same rigorous testing regime we developed with Martin-Baker: ejection seat trials, temperature extremes, impact and vibration — because we believe in building watches that can go anywhere you do. The Altitude MB Meteor with Orange Barrel isn’t just a watch — it’s a nod to our past, a statement of bold intent, and a reminder of what we stand for: precision, purpose, and the relentless pursuit of performance. We built it for those who push limits. We built it for you.

watches.name: Altitude Perpetual Calendar GMT
watches.description: At the pinnacle of Bremont’s Altitude Collection stands the Perpetual Calendar GMT Mono-pusher — a rare and refined timepiece limited to just 50 pieces worldwide. Housed in a lightweight 42mm Trip-Tick titanium case, with a brushed ‘Air Force Blue’ dial and case barrel, this watch combines two prestigious complications in a design rooted in aviation utility and everyday wearability. Inside, a hand-wound BHC9192-MH calibre forms the base, with a bespoke perpetual calendar and GMT module developed exclusively with Geneva’s renowned atelier, Agenhor. The display is beautifully balanced, with a rotating globe at 12 o’clock indicating a second time zone, and subdials at 3, 6, and 9 o’clock presenting the month/leap year cycle, date, and running seconds respectively. Despite its mechanical complexity, all functions are easily adjusted via an integrated mono-pusher crown and discreet correctors. Crafted to deliver enduring performance and refined precision, the Altitude Perpetual Calendar GMT is finished with a glassbox sapphire crystal and is offered on both a titanium bracelet and patinated blue leather strap. A showcase of British design, Swiss horological mastery and high complication craftsmanship — built for those who appreciate the rare and exceptional.

watches.name: Supermarine 500m
watches.description: The Supermarine 500m marks a bold new chapter in Bremont’s professional dive watch collection. Crafted in 904L stainless steel, the 43mm case features a slimmer, more ergonomic profile with enhanced crown and bezel guards for added durability. The dial introduces a striking new wave-pattern design, inspired by the ocean’s surface. Applied Super-LumiNova® indexes and sword hands ensure exceptional legibility in low light, while a domed sapphire crystal enhances clarity and adds a refined finish. Powered by the automatic BB64 movement with a 56-hour power reserve, the Supermarine 500m offers uncompromising performance beneath the surface. Available on Bremont’s newly engineered quick-release Supermarine bracelet – with micro-adjustment and polished-satin infinity links – or a high-performance rubber or NATO strap, this is a rugged yet refined dive watch made for those who take it further.

watches.name: Altitude Chronograph GMT
watches.description: The Altitude Chronograph GMT is the ultimate evolution of Bremont’s aviation tool watch — combining the proven resilience of the MB series with the added functionality of a chronograph and GMT complication. Housed in a 42mm Trip-Tick case made from ultra-rugged 904L stainless steel, with a black DLC-coated centre barrel, the watch has been engineered to withstand the harshest conditions. Inside, the chronometer-rated BC781 movement delivers a 62-hour power reserve and features a quick-set date, hacking seconds, and independent GMT hand. Beneath the surface, the automatic movement is suspended within a flexible rubber mount to absorb shocks and minimise impacts. The Altitude Chronograph GMT has an open case-back, revealing the movement’s fine finishing in gunmetal grey with Geneva Stripes. The open case-back retains the anti-magnetic shielding, which is provided by a soft iron ring around the movement, based on Faraday Cage principles. The dial design is clean, legible, and cockpit-inspired, with applied Super-LumiNova® numerals and indexes, and recessed chronograph subdials. A red-tipped GMT hand tracks a second time zone against a 24-hour day/night scale, while the rotating seconds subdial at 9 o’clock takes the form of a tri-blade propeller — a nod to a Bremont military project.

watches.name: Supermarine 300M Date, Bi-Colour
watches.description: Introducing the Supermarine 300m Date Bi-Colour, featuring a sleek profile case shape crafted in 904L stainless steel and 18ct rose gold. The 18ct rose gold-capped, knurled-edged bezel showcases trapezoid indexes on the uni-directional brown aluminum insert, seamlessly transitioning onto the dial to form a naval-inspired crosshair that draws the eye to the striking brown gradient dial. Enhancing this design is the superior durability of the 904L steel case, an evolution from the previous 316L steel, paired with the clarity of applied indexes and Super-LumiNova® for exceptional visibility in low light. Completing the look is the elegant 18ct rose gold-capped screw-in crown. Turning the case over reveals a case back engraved with a map of the world’s oceans, highlighting the purpose-driven design of this practical yet elegant sports watch. Continuing our commitment to innovation, the Supermarine 300m Date Bi-Colour is fitted with our newly designed 904L steel bracelet. Featuring alternating polished and satin-finished infinity-shaped links, it offers exceptional fluidity and versatility. For those seeking alternative styles, the Supermarine 300m Date Bi-Colour can also be paired with a quick-release brown leather strap with cream side stitch, adding its own distinctive character.

watches.name: Supermarine 300M GMT, 'Tundra' Green
watches.description: Inspired by Iceland’s rugged landscapes and tested in the country’s unforgiving elements, the Supermarine GMT in 'Tundra' Green embodies the spirit of adventure and resilience at the heart of Bremont. This exceptional 300m water-resistant GMT watch combines bold design and premium functionality, perfect for divers, travelers, and adventurers alike. The 'Tundra' Green edition features a striking linear gradient dial, which draws the eye to its center, complemented by a bi-directional, bi-colored 24-hour aluminium bezel. Vivid orange accents on the GMT hand and select markers add a burst of colour, enhancing readability and adding a unique visual edge. Beneath its anti-reflective sapphire crystal, the GMT boasts the latest Super-LumiNova® technology, with blue-emission luminescence on the dial indexes and green-emission luminescence on the GMT hand, ensuring optimal visibility in all lighting conditions. The Supermarine GMT is powered by a modified calibre automatic movement with a 50-hour power reserve. Constructed from durable 904L stainless steel, the watch’s slimmer profile and ergonomic quick-release bracelet are designed for both comfort and longevity. The infinity-shaped links and micro-adjust clasp provide a refined, adaptable fit, while the option of a durable chevron rubber strap enhances versatility for any adventure. On the reverse, a closed case back engraved with the world’s oceans pays homage to Bremont’s dedication to marine exploration. The Supermarine GMT in 'Tundra' Green is a core model in Bremont’s Supermarine collection.

watches.description: Inspired by Iceland’s rugged landscapes and tested in the country’s unforgiving elements, the Supermarine GMT in 'Tundra' Green embodies the spirit of adventure and resilience at the heart of Bremont. This exceptional 300m water-resistant GMT watch combines bold design and premium functionality, perfect for divers, travelers, and adventurers alike. The 'Tundra' Green edition features a striking linear gradient dial, which draws the eye to its center, complemented by a bi-directional, bi-colored 24-hour aluminium bezel. Vivid orange accents on the GMT hand and select markers add a burst of colour, enhancing readability and adding a unique visual edge. Beneath its anti-reflective sapphire crystal, the GMT boasts the latest Super-LumiNova® technology, with blue-emission luminescence on the dial indexes and green-emission luminescence on the GMT hand, ensuring optimal visibility in all lighting conditions. The Supermarine GMT is powered by a modified calibre automatic movement with a 50-hour power reserve. Constructed from durable 904L stainless steel, the watch’s slimmer profile and ergonomic quick-release bracelet are designed for both comfort and longevity. The infinity-shaped links and micro-adjust clasp provide a refined, adaptable fit, while the option of a durable chevron rubber strap enhances versatility for any adventure. On the reverse, a closed case back engraved with the world’s oceans pays homage to Bremont’s dedication to marine exploration. The Supermarine GMT in 'Tundra' Green is a core model in Bremont’s Supermarine collection.

watches.name: Terra Nova 40.5 Date 'Caramel'
watches.description: Introducing the Limited Edition Terra Nova 40.5 Date, featuring a striking, vintage-inspired 'Caramel' dial. watches.name: Supermarine Full Ceramic, Tactical Black
watches.description: Bremont introduces the next generation of Supermarine: a 500m Full Ceramic, striking, high-performance timepiece. Extensively tested by Bremont ambassador and extreme environment specialist Aldo Kane, a former Royal Marine, Bremont consistently strives to craft the best tool watches for the most arduous environments. Featuring a mono-block black ceramic case, black ceramic bezel insert, and a knurled detail PVD treated titanium bezel. Crafting a full ceramic case is a meticulous process. Soft ceramic powder is moulded and then sintered at 1,450°C under extreme pressure, shrinking the case by 23% to achieve perfect hardness. The result? A perfectly sand-blasted, extremely scratch-resistant matte finish ceramic case, built to endure any adventure. The 50-hour power reserve automatic movement sits in a titanium container, secured with a PVD treated titanium case back. With an impressive 500-metre water resistance and a helium escape valve, it's engineered for the depths while maintaining precise performance. The full ceramic case not only enhances durability but also adds a sleek, modern aesthetic, making it a watch that performs as brilliantly as it looks, both above and below the waves. The Supermarine Full Ceramic features applied indexes and hands which are filled with blue emission Super-LumiNova® allowing for longstanding and incredibly bright luminosity in the most challenging conditions and adds a touch of magic to your timepiece in low light. Includes our black and green woven fabric NATO style strap, meticulously woven on 18th century Jacquard French looms. Self-gripping fastening ensures a secure and comfortable fit.

watches.name: Terra Nova Dual-Time Tourbillon
watches.description: At Bremont, where we blend the traditional artistry of watchmaking with modern innovation, we hold the tourbillon in the highest regard. Our Terra Nova Dual-Time Tourbillon, first unveiled at Watches and Wonders Geneva in 2024, balances high-end watchmaking with the practicality of a tool watch. It’s a work of art designed to be worn and admired. The complex movement has been developed in collaboration with French, Swiss-based watchmaker Olivier Mory, using his tourbillon module to create a complication dedicated to travel and exploration. Our tourbillon has been intricately hand-assembled by our talented team of watchmakers at ‘The Wing’ in Henley-on-Thames. Limited to only 30 pieces, this unique variation is crafted from DLC-coated titanium and features a dual-time zone expressed through a 3-dimensional spherical dome. This not only gives a second-time zone but also displays a map of the world with meridian lines to indicate night and day. The hand-wound original 9130 Calibre Tourbillon carries a 100m water resistance, 100-hour power reserve and an accuracy of -3/+7 seconds per day.

watches.name: Supermarine 300M Date
watches.description: The new Supermarine 300m and 300m Date models have been entirely redesigned and now feature a new, sleeker and slimmer profile case shape crafted in 904L steel to maximise robustness and comfort in unison. This new symmetrical case silhouette includes both crown and bezel guards, ensuring practical operation whilst increasing durability and safety by preventing accidental adjustment or damage through shocks or knocks. The anodised aluminium knurled edged bezel features trapezoid indexes which flow from the bezel onto the dial, forming a naval inspired cross-hair, drawing the eye to the centre of the striking gradient dial. This is combined with improved durability, the clarity of applied indexes and the use of Super-LumiNova® for visibility in low light conditions. An entirely new 904L steel bracelet has been developed for the Supermarine range offering exceptional fluidity and quality with an undulating shape which is well suited to all wrist sizes. Infinity shaped links alternate in a polished and satin finish. The watch is also available with a new military influenced chevron performance rubber strap or a vintage brown leather lifestyle strap with top stitching. The case back is engraved with a map of the world’s oceans, emphasising the intent of the this practical elegant sports watch.
